breakdown.description: M_n = Σ(N_i M_i^2) / Σ(N_i M_i); use M_n = Σ(N_i M_i) / ΣN_i; the setup substitutes the weight-average formula while asking for the number-average molecular weight.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to fix the core inconsistency. The incomplete prompt provided the incorrect formula for number-average molecular weight (M_n). The ground truth corrects this by removing the incorrect formula, implying the correct one (M_n = Σ(N_i M_i) / ΣN_i) should be used. The agent, however, repeated the user's incorrect formula (M_n = Σ(N_i M_i^2) / Σ(N_i M_i)) and explicitly instructed the model to use it, thereby failing to resolve the error.
